_comment: Mutations that put the DEAD-FEED hole back into the symbol guard.
PR #54 round 2 measured three things in code, not by argument:
1. THIS fork's OWN frontend socket (/ws, /ws/main) cannot deliver a
symbol to the bot.  api/websocket_server.py:228-230 closes every
connection that carries no ?token= and the bot's screener client
sends none (data_consumer.py:3414-3437); the server forwards Redis
messages as {'topic','payload'} (:187-191) while the bot only
understands {'type':'active_pairs_update','data':[...]}
(data_consumer.py:3476-3478); and nothing in this repository
publishes that message at all.  The URL this fork SHIPPED in
.env.example was exactly that URL, and the guard accepted it.
2. A feed that is switched OFF has NO symbol source at all: the
DYNAMIC symbol pool is filled only by the feed's
'active_pairs_update' message (controller.py:7216), and there is
no automatic fallback to the static list.
3. A URL that is set but unusable is wrong in BOTH pairings: it is
the cause the moment the feed is switched on.
Every mutant below must be KILLED by the tests named in pytest_target.
The target is a LIST OF TEST NODES, not the whole file, so a kill is
attributable to the mutant and not to some unrelated failure.
Run with:  python tools/mutation_harness.py tools/mutations/screener_ws_delivery_guard.json
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: D1: this fork's OWN frontend socket is accepted as a feed again (the URL this fork shipped)
mutations.replace:
if False:  # MUTANT: this fork's own frontend socket is accepted
        return _fork_own_feed_message(text)

mutations.label: D2: FALSE POSITIVE - the fork's own socket check becomes a PATH-ONLY check, so an operator's own host on /ws/main is refused
mutations.replace: return ws_url_path(url) in FORK_OWN_WS_PATHS  # MUTANT: path only

mutations.label: D3: FALSE POSITIVE - the fork's own socket check becomes a HOST-ONLY check, so ANY path on the fork's own host is refused
mutations.replace: return ws_url_host(url) == FORK_OWN_DOMAIN  # MUTANT: host only

mutations.label: D4: the path comparison stops dropping the trailing slash, so '/ws/main/' slips past
mutations.replace: return path.lower()  # MUTANT: the trailing slash is not dropped

mutations.label: D5: the feed-off refusal names the wrong thing, so the operator is not told which switch is off
mutations.replace: return _upstream_url_message(text, ws_url_host(text))  # MUTANT: the wrong message

mutations.label: D6: the regime predicate accepts this fork's own frontend socket again
mutations.replace:
if False:  # MUTANT: the fork's own socket is accepted
        return False

mutations.label: D7: the regime predicate accepts the UPSTREAM's reserved hostname again
mutations.replace:
if False:  # MUTANT: the upstream is accepted
        return False

mutations.label: D8: the rehydrate exemption is gone, so a RUNNING strategy vanishes on restart
mutations.replace: if _dynamic_problem:  # MUTANT: the rehydrate exemption is gone

mutations.label: D9: the refusal never fires, so a DYNAMIC strategy starts against a feed that cannot deliver a symbol
